question.problem:
Which of the following determinants are equal to $0?$

$$
|A|=|\begin{aligned}7 & \sqrt{2} & 1 \\ 1 & -1 & 3 \\ 14 & 2\sqrt{2} & 2\end{aligned}|,\,|B|=|\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 4 \\ -1 & 3 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}|,\,|C|=|\begin{aligned}2 & 0 & 0 \\ 3 & -3 & 0 \\ 0 & -3 & -1\end{aligned}|
$$
question.worked_solution:
Let's examine each of the given determinants in turn.

- The matrix $A$ has proportional rows: 

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}7 & \sqrt{2} & 1 \\ 1 & -1 & 3 \\ 14 & 2\sqrt{2} & 2\end{aligned}]
$$

As a result, $|A|=0.$

- The matrix $B$ has a zero row: 

$$
B=[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 4 \\ -1 & 3 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

As a result, $|B|=0.$

- The matrix $C$ is a triangular matrix, hence 

$$
|C|=2\cdot (-3)\cdot (-1)=6\ne 0.
$$

Therefore, only $|A|$ and $|B|$ are equal to $0.$
